Agricultural trade faces three connected gaps

text: Fragmented market access, weak product evidence, and limited price visibility create risk for every participant.
textPreview: Fragmented market access, weak product evidence, and limited price visibility create risk for every participant.

text: Farmers may face harvest-time oversupply while buyers elsewhere cannot identify reliable suppliers with the quantity and schedule they need.
textPreview: Farmers may face harvest-time oversupply while buyers elsewhere cannot identify reliable suppliers with the quantity and schedule they need.

text: Buyers often depend on seller descriptions because cultivation history, harvest dates, and certificates are difficult to verify.
textPreview: Buyers often depend on seller descriptions because cultivation history, harvest dates, and certificates are difficult to verify.

text: Fragmented and outdated regional price information makes it hard to judge whether an offer is fair.
